# New York Daily News
> New York Daily News is a metropolitan news site covering New York City breaking news, politics, crime, sports, entertainment, and local life.

It publishes daily reporting focused on NYC and the surrounding region, with major coverage areas including local news, public safety, government, business, opinion, sports, and things to do.

## Main Sections
- [Home](https://www.nydailynews.com/): Front page with top stories, breaking news, sports, weather, and featured local coverage.
- [News](https://www.nydailynews.com/news/): Main news hub for local, national, and developing stories.
- [Sports](https://www.nydailynews.com/sports/): Sports coverage centered on New York teams, leagues, and analysis.
- [Entertainment](https://www.nydailynews.com/entertainment/): Celebrity, television, movies, music, and culture reporting.
- [Opinion](https://www.nydailynews.com/opinion/): Editorials, columns, endorsements, and reader-focused commentary.
- [Business](https://www.nydailynews.com/business/): Business, economy, real estate, and consumer-focused reporting.

## New York News
- [New York News](https://www.nydailynews.com/new-york/): Coverage of NYC neighborhoods, city agencies, transit, schools, and local issues.
- [Crime & Public Safety](https://www.nydailynews.com/news/crime-public-safety/): Reporting on crime, policing, courts, and public safety developments.
- [Politics](https://www.nydailynews.com/news/politics/): Local, state, and national political coverage affecting New Yorkers.
- [Education](https://www.nydailynews.com/new-york/education/): News on schools, students, policy changes, and education systems.
- [Transportation](https://www.nydailynews.com/new-york/transportation/): Coverage of subways, buses, traffic, airports, and commuting issues.
- [Weather](https://www.nydailynews.com/weather/): Forecasts, storm coverage, and weather-related local updates.

## Boroughs & Local Areas
- [Bronx](https://www.nydailynews.com/new-york/bronx/): Local reporting from the Bronx on neighborhoods, schools, crime, and politics.
- [Brooklyn](https://www.nydailynews.com/new-york/brooklyn/): Brooklyn-focused news covering communities, development, and public safety.
- [Manhattan](https://www.nydailynews.com/new-york/manhattan/): Manhattan news on city life, government, transit, and local events.
- [Queens](https://www.nydailynews.com/new-york/queens/): Queens coverage including neighborhoods, crime, transit, and civic issues.
- [Staten Island](https://www.nydailynews.com/new-york/staten-island/): Staten Island reporting on local government, community news, and development.
- [Long Island](https://www.nydailynews.com/new-york/long-island/): Regional coverage of Long Island news, politics, and public safety.

## Sports Teams & Leagues
- [New York Yankees](https://www.nydailynews.com/sports/baseball/yankees/): Yankees news, game coverage, roster updates, and analysis.
- [New York Mets](https://www.nydailynews.com/sports/baseball/mets/): Mets reporting with scores, injuries, trades, and commentary.
- [New York Giants](https://www.nydailynews.com/sports/football/giants/): Giants coverage including games, coaching, and roster developments.
- [New York Jets](https://www.nydailynews.com/sports/football/jets/): Jets news, analysis, and season coverage.
- [New York Knicks](https://www.nydailynews.com/sports/basketball/knicks/): Knicks reporting with game recaps, player news, and opinion.
- [Brooklyn Nets](https://www.nydailynews.com/sports/basketball/nets/): Nets coverage focused on games, transactions, and team analysis.
- [New York Rangers](https://www.nydailynews.com/sports/hockey/rangers/): Rangers news, results, and hockey analysis.
- [New York Islanders](https://www.nydailynews.com/sports/hockey/islanders/): Islanders coverage with game stories and roster updates.

## Entertainment & Lifestyle
- [Entertainment](https://www.nydailynews.com/entertainment/): Hub for celebrity, TV, film, music, and pop culture stories.
- [Things to Do](https://www.nydailynews.com/things-to-do/): Guides to events, attractions, dining, and activities around New York.
- [Movies](https://www.nydailynews.com/entertainment/movies/): Film news, reviews, trailers, and industry coverage.
- [Television](https://www.nydailynews.com/entertainment/tv/): TV news, streaming coverage, interviews, and reviews.
- [Music](https://www.nydailynews.com/entertainment/music/): Music reporting, artist news, releases, and concert coverage.
- [Celebrity](https://www.nydailynews.com/entertainment/gossip/): Celebrity and gossip coverage from entertainment reporters.

## Opinion & Editorial
- [Opinion](https://www.nydailynews.com/opinion/): Opinion homepage featuring editorials, columns, and commentary.
- [Editorials](https://www.nydailynews.com/opinion/editorials/): Institutional editorials on politics, policy, and civic issues.
- [Columnists](https://www.nydailynews.com/opinion/columnists/): Staff and guest columns on news, culture, and public affairs.
- [Letters to the Editor](https://www.nydailynews.com/opinion/letters/): Reader responses and community perspectives on current events.

## Business & Consumer
- [Business](https://www.nydailynews.com/business/): Business news covering markets, jobs, housing, and the local economy.
- [Real Estate](https://www.nydailynews.com/business/real-estate/): Reporting on housing, development, rents, and property trends.
- [Consumer Reviews](https://www.nydailynews.com/reviews/): Product and service review content for consumer decision-making.

## Special Coverage & Media
- [Photos](https://www.nydailynews.com/news/photography/): News photography and visual coverage from Daily News staff.
- [Video](https://www.nydailynews.com/video/): Video reports, interviews, clips, and visual storytelling.
- [Obituaries](https://www.nydailynews.com/obituaries/): Obituary notices and memorial coverage.
- [Comics](https://www.nydailynews.com/comics/): Daily comics and cartoon features.
- [Horoscopes](https://www.nydailynews.com/horoscopes/): Daily horoscope content and astrology features.

## Puzzles & Games
- [Games](https://www.nydailynews.com/games/): Hub for interactive puzzles and casual games.
- [Crossword](https://www.nydailynews.com/games/daily-crossword/): Daily crossword puzzle for regular solvers.
- [Sudoku](https://www.nydailynews.com/games/daily-sudoku/): Daily Sudoku puzzle with varying difficulty.
- [Jumble](https://www.nydailynews.com/games/daily-jumble/): Daily word scramble puzzle feature.
- [Word Search](https://www.nydailynews.com/games/daily-word-search/): Daily word search puzzle for casual play.
